body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Venice, Italy. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 2.0 km. It starts at Venice Tours Office, Calle de le Rasse 4536, Venice. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to St. Mark's Campanile (exchange your voucher for a paper ticket at the Venice Tours Office, Calle de le Rasse 4536). The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The ticket to St. Mark’s Campanile is included in this self-guided walking audio tour of Venice’s landmarks and local life.
>
> NB! Before visiting the Campanile, exchange your voucher for a paper ticket at the Venice Tours Office, Calle de le Rasse 4536, Venice.
>
> Begin at St. Mark’s Campanile, where your ticket gives you access to the elevator and the top of the tower, offering sweeping views across Venice. Please note that the audio guide inside the Campanile is not included in this bundle. It is available separately on site through a dedicated app.
>
> After visiting the Campanile, resume this self-guided audio tour and explore the sights you’ve just admired from above. Discover Piazza San Marco and learn about its iconic landmarks, including the Doge’s Palace and St. Mark’s Basilica. Then leave the bustle of the square behind and wander through quieter lanes and picturesque campos.
>
> The route continues to Campo dei Frari and Carlo Goldoni’s House before taking you to the Gallerie dell’Accademia and along the Grand Canal. Your journey ends at the Rialto Bridge.
>
> Along the way, admire ornate façades, pause in lively squares, and watch boats glide along the Grand Canal as you discover Venice at your own pace.
